description: Apex tests that fail on aer, the local Apex runtime, and pass in a Salesforce org. scripts/aer-run.js --gate fails on any other failure and on a test that reports no result. Categories: "runtime gap" (aer behaves differently from Salesforce, shown), "profile" (the copy has no profiles folder) and "unclassified" (the cause is not yet known).

failures.error: Passes in a Salesforce org, and passed on aer 1.4.38. On aer 1.4.45 a 15-character Id in a bound list of Ids does not match its record, so the query returns only the record given by its 18-character Id. First error on aer: AssertException: QRY_Condition_TEST.cls:1158: Assertion Failed: Expected the query to find the two records: Expected: {a05aer000000001AAA, a05aer000000002AAA}, Actual: {a05aer000000001AAA}
